summary: Implemented Graph.cbd in rdflib/graph.py (last method of Graph, before ConjunctiveGraph) using a nested add_to_cbd helper that applies the W3C CBD rules: subject triples, recursion into BNode objects not yet described (cycle-guarded), and reification via rdf:subject with no rdf:Statement or predicate/object matching. Added test/test_graph_cbd.py with CbdTestCase (testCbd, testCbdReified, testCbdIncomingReification, testCbdReifierBlankNodeNotExpanded, testCbdBlankNodeCycle, testCbdSourceUnchanged) and a Turtle fixture with hand-derived expected counts. Nothing was run, per instructions; changes are uncommitted and verified by reading only.
